text:
Mira: Heads up — found multiple GCP SA key blobs in a partner webhook payloads from staging. Same key appears reused across a couple services. Need immediate rotation + RBAC lockdown. Who can own takedown?

Tony: cc @Samir. First priority: identify SA and key IDs. Prefer disable (not delete) to avoid breaking deploys.

Mira: Quick snippet from logs (redacted): `ya29.c.K...` — found via BigQuery on request payloads. Query I ran (partial): `SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, count(*) FROM `redwood-logs.request_*` WHERE resource.labels.project_id='redwood-staging' AND textPayload LIKE '%ya29.%' GROUP BY principalEmail` — running a full extraction now.

Samir: I'm on it. Will scan IAM bindings + terraform state. Starting w/ these commands: 
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=ci-staging@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-staging --format=json
```
and
```
gsutil ls -r gs://redwood-staging-logs/** | xargs grep -n "ci-staging@"
```
I'll also run this BigQuery to surface token usage in the last 14 days: 
```
SELECT timestamp, jsonPayload.request.auth.sub, jsonPayload.request.path
FROM `redwood-logs.audit_*`
WHERE jsonPayload.request.auth.sub LIKE "%ci-staging@%"
  AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 14 DAY)
```

Jen (vault-ops-bot): Alert: vault-transit-rewrap failed on key=partner-wrap-01: error="ciphertext verification failed" at 2024-07-18T14:23Z

Mira: That matches partner saying rewraps started failing after their KMS rotate. We likely have mismatched KMS key version metadata in Vault — need manual rewrap fallback.

Tony: Proposed immediate plan:
- Step 1 (now): Disable the SA key in GCP (not delete), remove from partner webhooks
- Step 2 (1–2h): Create new SA key, generate short-lived tokens, push to Vault as transit-wrapped ciphertext
- Step 3: Update RBAC: remove broad bindings (no more editor), attach least-priv roles required (logging.write + pubsub.publish / specific APIs)
- Step 4: Add audit sink & detection for partner webhook plaintext exposures
- Step 5: Post-incident sweep: search GCS/S3/terraform for any other instances and remediate

Samir: I'll own steps 1–2. Mira, you own partner comms. Tony will handle RBAC & audit sink. ETA 3h to rotate and patch.

Mira: When you create the new key, store it in Vault using these commands (example):
```
vault write secret/partner/ci-staging value=@/tmp/ci-staging-key.json
vault write transit/encrypt/partner-wrap key=partner-wrap-01 plaintext=$(base64 /tmp/ci-staging-key.json)
```

Samir: Noted. For the rewrap failure, a controlled rewrap attempt could be: 
```
vault operator rewrap -prefix=transit/ -concurrency=4
```
But will confirm w/ ops before triggering mass rewrap; may prefer manual single-key rewrap.

Tony: RBAC rollback snippet to reduce privileges quickly: 
```
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-staging \
  --member='serviceAccount:ci-staging@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
  --role='roles/editor'

gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-staging \
  --member='serviceAccount:ci-staging@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
  --role='roles/logging.logWriter'
```

Mira: Scheduling a 30m emergency sync at 15:00 UTC to coordinate handoffs. Owners: samir (incident-owner), mira (partner comms), tony (rbac + audit).

Oncall Bot: Created incident INC-2024-411 in PagerDuty, linked to #incidents.

Tony: Quick operational note — do NOT delete keys until rotated and verified. Prefer disable + revoke. We'll run a follow-up postmortem and add HV integrations policy + automated detection rules for webhook payloads. :warning:
